properties.NAME: Vermont
properties.CHANGE: Vermont declared its independence from New York. Although not recognized as a separate state by the Continental Congress, Vermont was included in American terr. by the 1783 Treaty of Paris & functioned as an independent republic until statehood in 1791.
properties.CITATION: (Slade, 70-73; Van Zandt, 64; C. Williamson, 82-84, map facing 95, 100-102, 112-113)
